title: 橋梁預力鋼腱更換
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring
summary: 從預鑄節塊箱梁外置鋼腱的荷載路徑與冗餘度出發，說明灌漿離析與泌水如何讓鋼絞線在低氯離子下仍然腐蝕斷裂，再處理可更換細部、舊鋼腱去張的能量控制、新鋼腱張拉與伸長量核對、全橋普查、振動與聲射監測，並以美國 Mid-Bay、Ringling 堤道與 Wando River 等橋的鋼腱更換為實例。
summaryEn: Starting from the load path and redundancy of external tendons in precast segmental box girders, explain how segregated, bleeding grout lets strands corrode and rupture even at low chloride, then cover replaceable detailing, energy control when detensioning the old tendon, force and elongation checks on the new one, network-wide surveys, and vibration and acoustic-emission monitoring, using the tendon replacements at the Mid-Bay, Ringling Causeway and Wando River bridges in the United States.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑」與「移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load path of external tendons" and "Joint stress with one tendon removed": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 外置鋼腱的荷載路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path of external tendons: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」如何影響橋梁預力鋼腱更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預鑄節塊箱梁的外置鋼腱位於箱室內、混凝土之外，只在錨定隔梁與轉向塊處與結構接觸：錨定處把預力以集中承壓傳入隔梁，轉向塊處鋼腱改變方向，產生向上的徑向力抵銷部分自重彎矩。因為鋼腱沿全長不與混凝土黏結，任何一處斷裂都會讓整條鋼腱在整個跨度內失去作用，而不像內置黏結鋼腱只在斷點附近局部失效；這正是外置鋼腱能夠更換、也必須事先規劃更換的原因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a precast segmental box girder, external tendons run inside the box cell outside the concrete and touch the structure only at anchorage diaphragms and deviators: the anchorages push prestress into the diaphragm as concentrated bearing, and at each deviator the tendon changes direction, producing an upward radial force that offsets part of the self-weight moment. Because the tendon is not bonded to the concrete along its length, a break anywhere deactivates it over the whole span, unlike a bonded internal tendon that loses effect only near the break; that is exactly why external tendons can be replaced and why their replacement must be planned in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外置鋼腱斷一條只影響斷點附近，其餘跨段照常有預力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "When one external tendon breaks, only the region near the break loses prestress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外置鋼腱的荷載路徑
knowledge.text: 預鑄節塊箱梁的外置鋼腱位於箱室內、混凝土之外，只在錨定隔梁與轉向塊處與結構接觸：錨定處把預力以集中承壓傳入隔梁，轉向塊處鋼腱改變方向，產生向上的徑向力抵銷部分自重彎矩。因為鋼腱沿全長不與混凝土黏結，任何一處斷裂都會讓整條鋼腱在整個跨度內失去作用，而不像內置黏結鋼腱只在斷點附近局部失效；這正是外置鋼腱能夠更換、也必須事先規劃更換的原因。
knowledge.textEn: In a precast segmental box girder, external tendons run inside the box cell outside the concrete and touch the structure only at anchorage diaphragms and deviators: the anchorages push prestress into the diaphragm as concentrated bearing, and at each deviator the tendon changes direction, producing an upward radial force that offsets part of the self-weight moment. Because the tendon is not bonded to the concrete along its length, a break anywhere deactivates it over the whole span, unlike a bonded internal tendon that loses effect only near the break; that is exactly why external tendons can be replaced and why their replacement must be planned in advance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外置鋼腱斷一條只影響斷點附近，其餘跨段照常有預力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: When one external tendon breaks, only the region near the break loses prestress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「橋梁預力鋼腱更換」的「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「城市結構維護班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Load path of external tendons: mechanism and load path” in “Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban structures maintenance shift” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path of external tendons" is correct?
options: 外置鋼腱斷一條只影響斷點附近，其餘跨段照常有預力。
預鑄節塊箱梁的外置鋼腱位於箱室內、混凝土之外，只在錨定隔梁與轉向塊處與結構接觸：錨定處把預力以集中承壓傳入隔梁，轉向塊處鋼腱改變方向，產生向上的徑向力抵銷部分自重彎矩。
只要其餘鋼腱沒斷，更換期間的橋就和平常一樣安全。
optionsEn: When one external tendon breaks, only the region near the break loses prestress.

In a precast segmental box girder, external tendons run inside the box cell outside the concrete and touch the structure only at anchorage diaphragms and deviators: the anchorages push prestress into the diaphragm as concentrated bearing, and at each deviator the tendon changes direction, producing an upward radial force that offsets part of the self-weight moment.
As long as the other tendons are intact, the bridge is as safe as usual during a replacement.
quiz.explanation: 預鑄節塊箱梁的外置鋼腱位於箱室內、混凝土之外，只在錨定隔梁與轉向塊處與結構接觸：錨定處把預力以集中承壓傳入隔梁，轉向塊處鋼腱改變方向，產生向上的徑向力抵銷部分自重彎矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a precast segmental box girder, external tendons run inside the box cell outside the concrete and touch the structure only at anchorage diaphragms and deviators: the anchorages push prestress into the diaphragm as concentrated bearing, and at each deviator the tendon changes direction, producing an upward radial force that offsets part of the self-weight moment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外置鋼腱的荷載路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path of external tendons: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：轉向力 F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2)。取有效預力 P = 2,970 kN（19 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、0.60 f_pu）、轉向角 Δθ = 6°，F = 2×2,970×sin3° ≈ 311 kN；一跨兩處轉向塊、六條鋼腱，總向上力約 2×6×311 ≈ 3,730 kN。失去一條鋼腱，這部分向上力就少約 622 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Deviator force F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2). With effective prestress P = 2,970 kN (19 strands of 15.2 mm at 0.60 f_pu) and a deviation of Δθ = 6°, F = 2×2,970×sin3° ≈ 311 kN; two deviators and six tendons per span give about 2×6×311 ≈ 3,730 kN of upward force. Losing one tendon removes about 622 kN of it. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以竣工圖與預力施工紀錄核對每條鋼腱的路線、轉向角與張拉力，並在結構模型中逐跨計算轉向力與錨定區承壓應力；現場檢查轉向塊與隔梁是否有放射狀裂縫、埋設鋼管滑出或混凝土剝落，拍照編號作為更換前的基準狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check each tendon's profile, deviation angles and stressing force against as-built drawings and stressing records, compute deviator forces and anchorage-zone bearing stresses span by span in the structural model, and inspect deviators and diaphragms for radial cracks, embedded pipes sliding out or spalling, photographing and numbering them as the baseline condition before any replacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 轉向力 F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2)。取有效預力 P = 2,970 kN（19 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、0.60 f_pu）、轉向角 Δθ = 6°，F = 2×2,970×sin3° ≈ 311 kN；一跨兩處轉向塊、六條鋼腱，總向上力約 2×6×311 ≈ 3,730 kN。失去一條鋼腱，這部分向上力就少約 622 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Deviator force F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2). With effective prestress P = 2,970 kN (19 strands of 15.2 mm at 0.60 f_pu) and a deviation of Δθ = 6°, F = 2×2,970×sin3° ≈ 311 kN; two deviators and six tendons per span give about 2×6×311 ≈ 3,730 kN of upward force. Losing one tendon removes about 622 kN of it. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path of external tendons", which statement holds?
options: 外置鋼腱因為看得到，天生就可以更換，不需要特別的細部。
千斤頂油壓達到目標值，就證明整條鋼腱的力量都正確。
轉向力 F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2)。
optionsEn: Because external tendons are visible, they are inherently replaceable without special detailing.
Reaching the target jack pressure proves the force is correct along the whole tendon.
Deviator force F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2).
quiz.explanation: 轉向力 F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Deviator force F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外置鋼腱的荷載路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path of external tendons: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以竣工圖與預力施工紀錄核對每條鋼腱的路線、轉向角與張拉力，並在結構模型中逐跨計算轉向力與錨定區承壓應力；現場檢查轉向塊與隔梁是否有放射狀裂縫、埋設鋼管滑出或混凝土剝落，拍照編號作為更換前的基準狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check each tendon's profile, deviation angles and stressing force against as-built drawings and stressing records, compute deviator forces and anchorage-zone bearing stresses span by span in the structural model, and inspect deviators and diaphragms for radial cracks, embedded pipes sliding out or spalling, photographing and numbering them as the baseline condition before any replacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計時就要在說明中寫明每一條外置鋼腱都可在交通管制下單獨更換，並在計算書逐跨列出移除任一條鋼腱時的應力檢核與所需交通限制，讓日後的管理單位不必重新推導。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State in the design that every external tendon can be replaced individually under traffic management, and list in the calculations, span by span, the stress check with any one tendon removed and the traffic restriction it requires, so the future owner does not have to re-derive it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：2000 年佛州 Mid-Bay 大橋例行檢查發現一條鋼腱因錨定區嚴重腐蝕而由伸縮縫隔梁拉脫、整條鬆弛，灌漿鋼管也在斷裂時被拉出隔梁；外置鋼腱斷裂時釋放的能量還可能撞擊並損壞轉向塊與箱室內設備。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In 2000 a routine inspection of Florida's Mid-Bay Bridge found a tendon that had separated from an expansion-joint diaphragm after severe anchorage-zone corrosion and gone completely slack, with its grouted steel pipe pulled out of the diaphragm during the rupture; the energy released by a breaking external tendon can also strike and damage deviators and equipment inside the box. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以竣工圖與預力施工紀錄核對每條鋼腱的路線、轉向角與張拉力，並在結構模型中逐跨計算轉向力與錨定區承壓應力；現場檢查轉向塊與隔梁是否有放射狀裂縫、埋設鋼管滑出或混凝土剝落，拍照編號作為更換前的基準狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Check each tendon's profile, deviation angles and stressing force against as-built drawings and stressing records, compute deviator forces and anchorage-zone bearing stresses span by span in the structural model, and inspect deviators and diaphragms for radial cracks, embedded pipes sliding out or spalling, photographing and numbering them as the baseline condition before any replacement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計時就要在說明中寫明每一條外置鋼腱都可在交通管制下單獨更換，並在計算書逐跨列出移除任一條鋼腱時的應力檢核與所需交通限制，讓日後的管理單位不必重新推導。
knowledge.textEn: State in the design that every external tendon can be replaced individually under traffic management, and list in the calculations, span by span, the stress check with any one tendon removed and the traffic restriction it requires, so the future owner does not have to re-derive it.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load path of external tendons"?
options: 以竣工圖與預力施工紀錄核對每條鋼腱的路線、轉向角與張拉力，並在結構模型中逐跨計算轉向力與錨定區承壓應力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
鋼腱振動頻率只要有變化，就一定是斷了鋼絲。
optionsEn: Check each tendon's profile, deviation angles and stressing force against as-built drawings and stressing records, compute deviator forces and anchorage-zone bearing stresses span by span in the structural model, and inspect deviators and diaphragms for radial cracks, embedded pipes sliding out or spalling, photographing and numbering them as the baseline condition before any replacement.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any change in a tendon's vibration frequency must mean broken wires.
quiz.explanation: 以竣工圖與預力施工紀錄核對每條鋼腱的路線、轉向角與張拉力，並在結構模型中逐跨計算轉向力與錨定區承壓應力；現場檢查轉向塊與隔梁是否有放射狀裂縫、埋設鋼管滑出或混凝土剝落，拍照編號作為更換前的基準狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check each tendon's profile, deviation angles and stressing force against as-built drawings and stressing records, compute deviator forces and anchorage-zone bearing stresses span by span in the structural model, and inspect deviators and diaphragms for radial cracks, embedded pipes sliding out or spalling, photographing and numbering them as the baseline condition before any replacement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外置鋼腱的荷載路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path of external tendons: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 2000 年佛州 Mid-Bay 大橋例行檢查發現一條鋼腱因錨定區嚴重腐蝕而由伸縮縫隔梁拉脫、整條鬆弛，灌漿鋼管也在斷裂時被拉出隔梁；外置鋼腱斷裂時釋放的能量還可能撞擊並損壞轉向塊與箱室內設備。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: In 2000 a routine inspection of Florida's Mid-Bay Bridge found a tendon that had separated from an expansion-joint diaphragm after severe anchorage-zone corrosion and gone completely slack, with its grouted steel pipe pulled out of the diaphragm during the rupture; the energy released by a breaking external tendon can also strike and damage deviators and equipment inside the box. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為鋼腱沿全長不與混凝土黏結，任何一處斷裂都會讓整條鋼腱在整個跨度內失去作用，而不像內置黏結鋼腱只在斷點附近局部失效；這正是外置鋼腱能夠更換、也必須事先規劃更換的原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the tendon is not bonded to the concrete along its length, a break anywhere deactivates it over the whole span, unlike a bonded internal tendon that loses effect only near the break; that is exactly why external tendons can be replaced and why their replacement must be planned in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外置鋼腱斷一條只影響斷點附近，其餘跨段照常有預力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "When one external tendon breaks, only the region near the break loses prestress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 2000 年佛州 Mid-Bay 大橋例行檢查發現一條鋼腱因錨定區嚴重腐蝕而由伸縮縫隔梁拉脫、整條鬆弛，灌漿鋼管也在斷裂時被拉出隔梁；外置鋼腱斷裂時釋放的能量還可能撞擊並損壞轉向塊與箱室內設備。
knowledge.textEn: In 2000 a routine inspection of Florida's Mid-Bay Bridge found a tendon that had separated from an expansion-joint diaphragm after severe anchorage-zone corrosion and gone completely slack, with its grouted steel pipe pulled out of the diaphragm during the rupture; the energy released by a breaking external tendon can also strike and damage deviators and equipment inside the box.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path of external tendons" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
2000 年佛州 Mid-Bay 大橋例行檢查發現一條鋼腱因錨定區嚴重腐蝕而由伸縮縫隔梁拉脫、整條鬆弛，灌漿鋼管也在斷裂時被拉出隔梁。
只要其餘鋼腱沒斷，更換期間的橋就和平常一樣安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

In 2000 a routine inspection of Florida's Mid-Bay Bridge found a tendon that had separated from an expansion-joint diaphragm after severe anchorage-zone corrosion and gone completely slack, with its grouted steel pipe pulled out of the diaphragm during the rupture.
As long as the other tendons are intact, the bridge is as safe as usual during a replacement.
quiz.explanation: 2000 年佛州 Mid-Bay 大橋例行檢查發現一條鋼腱因錨定區嚴重腐蝕而由伸縮縫隔梁拉脫、整條鬆弛，灌漿鋼管也在斷裂時被拉出隔梁；外置鋼腱斷裂時釋放的能量還可能撞擊並損壞轉向塊與箱室內設備。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In 2000 a routine inspection of Florida's Mid-Bay Bridge found a tendon that had separated from an expansion-joint diaphragm after severe anchorage-zone corrosion and gone completely slack, with its grouted steel pipe pulled out of the diaphragm during the rupture; the energy released by a breaking external tendon can also strike and damage deviators and equipment inside the box. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint stress with one tendon removed: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「節塊接縫底緣應力」如何影響橋梁預力鋼腱更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bottom-fibre stress at segment joints” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預鑄節塊之間的接縫通常沒有鋼筋穿越，接縫能否保持閉合完全依賴預力在底緣留下的壓應力。正常使用時，預力的軸壓與偏心彎矩抵銷恆載與活載彎矩，使底緣仍保有少量壓應力儲備；更換鋼腱時必須先把舊鋼腱去張，等於在施工期間主動讓該跨少一條鋼腱數週。因此更換工程的第一個問題不是怎麼切，而是少一條鋼腱時接縫會不會出現拉應力而張開，以及需要多少交通管制或臨時預力才能避免。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「節塊接縫底緣應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joints between precast segments usually have no reinforcement crossing them, so whether a joint stays closed depends entirely on the compression that prestress leaves in the bottom fibre. In service, the axial prestress and its eccentric moment offset dead- and live-load moments, leaving a small compressive reserve; replacing a tendon means deliberately detensioning the old one, so the span works one tendon short for weeks. The first question of a replacement is therefore not how to cut, but whether the joints decompress and open with one tendon missing, and how much traffic restriction or temporary prestress prevents it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bottom-fibre stress at segment joints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要其餘鋼腱沒斷，更換期間的橋就和平常一樣安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the other tendons are intact, the bridge is as safe as usual during a replacement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「節塊接縫底緣應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bottom-fibre stress at segment joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力
knowledge.titleEn: Joint stress with one tendon removed
knowledge.text: 預鑄節塊之間的接縫通常沒有鋼筋穿越，接縫能否保持閉合完全依賴預力在底緣留下的壓應力。正常使用時，預力的軸壓與偏心彎矩抵銷恆載與活載彎矩，使底緣仍保有少量壓應力儲備；更換鋼腱時必須先把舊鋼腱去張，等於在施工期間主動讓該跨少一條鋼腱數週。
knowledge.textEn: Joints between precast segments usually have no reinforcement crossing them, so whether a joint stays closed depends entirely on the compression that prestress leaves in the bottom fibre. In service, the axial prestress and its eccentric moment offset dead- and live-load moments, leaving a small compressive reserve; replacing a tendon means deliberately detensioning the old one, so the span works one tendon short for weeks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要其餘鋼腱沒斷，更換期間的橋就和平常一樣安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the other tendons are intact, the bridge is as safe as usual during a replacement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint stress with one tendon removed" is correct?
options: 只要其餘鋼腱沒斷，更換期間的橋就和平常一樣安全。
只要灌漿的氯離子含量很低，鋼腱就不會腐蝕。
預鑄節塊之間的接縫通常沒有鋼筋穿越，接縫能否保持閉合完全依賴預力在底緣留下的壓應力。
optionsEn: As long as the other tendons are intact, the bridge is as safe as usual during a replacement.
If grout chloride content is very low, the tendon cannot corrode.
Joints between precast segments usually have no reinforcement crossing them, so whether a joint stays closed depends entirely on the compression that prestress leaves in the bottom fibre.
quiz.explanation: 預鑄節塊之間的接縫通常沒有鋼筋穿越，接縫能否保持閉合完全依賴預力在底緣留下的壓應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joints between precast segments usually have no reinforcement crossing them, so whether a joint stays closed depends entirely on the compression that prestress leaves in the bottom fibre. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint stress with one tendon removed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節塊接縫底緣應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bottom-fibre stress at segment joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b。設 A = 6.0 m²、S_b = 3.5 m³、e = 1.2 m、M = 30 MN·m。六條鋼腱 P = 17.82 MN：σ_b = −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 ≈ −0.51 MPa（受壓）；去掉一條後 P = 14.85 MN：σ_b = −2.48 − 5.09 + 8.57 ≈ +1.00 MPa（受拉，接縫可能張開）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b. Take A = 6.0 m², S_b = 3.5 m³, e = 1.2 m and M = 30 MN·m. With six tendons, P = 17.82 MN gives σ_b = −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 ≈ −0.51 MPa (compression); with one removed, P = 14.85 MN gives σ_b = −2.48 − 5.09 + 8.57 ≈ +1.00 MPa (tension, the joint may open). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段模型逐步模擬「舊鋼腱去張、空缺期、新鋼腱張拉」三個狀態，檢查每個接縫在設計活載與溫度梯度下的應力；現場在接縫兩側安裝裂縫計或位移計，去張期間連續記錄接縫開口，超過預定警戒值（例如 0.1 mm）即停工檢討。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Model the three construction states, old tendon detensioned, gap period and new tendon stressed, and check every joint under design live load and thermal gradient; on site, fit crack gauges or displacement transducers across joints and log opening continuously during detensioning, stopping work for review if a preset alert value such as 0.1 mm is exceeded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b. Take A = 6.0 m², S_b = 3.5 m³, e = 1.2 m and M = 30 MN·m. With six tendons, P = 17.82 MN gives σ_b = −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 ≈ −0.51 MPa (compression); with one removed, P = 14.85 MN gives σ_b = −2.48 − 5.09 + 8.57 ≈ +1.00 MPa (tension, the joint may open). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint stress with one tendon removed", which statement holds?
options: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b。
鋼腱已經斷了一部分，剩下的鋼絞線可以直接在錨頭燒斷。
只要套管外觀沒有裂縫，裡面的鋼腱就一定完好。
optionsEn: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b.
Once part of a tendon has broken, the remaining strands can simply be torched off at the anchorage.
If the duct shows no cracks outside, the tendon inside must be sound.
quiz.explanation: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint stress with one tendon removed: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節塊接縫底緣應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bottom-fibre stress at segment joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段模型逐步模擬「舊鋼腱去張、空缺期、新鋼腱張拉」三個狀態，檢查每個接縫在設計活載與溫度梯度下的應力；現場在接縫兩側安裝裂縫計或位移計，去張期間連續記錄接縫開口，超過預定警戒值（例如 0.1 mm）即停工檢討。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Model the three construction states, old tendon detensioned, gap period and new tendon stressed, and check every joint under design live load and thermal gradient; on site, fit crack gauges or displacement transducers across joints and log opening continuously during detensioning, stopping work for review if a preset alert value such as 0.1 mm is exceeded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：更換計畫應附上每一跨、每一條鋼腱移除時所需的交通限制表（車道封閉、重車禁行或限速），以及必要時的臨時預力棒配置，由原設計者或獨立審查工程師簽認後才能動工。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The replacement plan should attach, for every span and every tendon, a table of required traffic restrictions (lane closure, heavy-vehicle ban or speed limit) and any temporary prestressing bars, signed by the original designer or an independent checking engineer before work starts.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沒有先算出少一條鋼腱的狀態就開放全部交通，接縫可能在重車通過時反覆張開又閉合，環氧樹脂接縫劣化、水氣進入，反而加速鄰近鋼腱的腐蝕，使一次更換演變成連鎖問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping the one-tendon-short check and keeping full traffic lets joints open and close under every heavy truck, degrading the epoxy joints and admitting moisture, which accelerates corrosion of the neighbouring tendons and turns one replacement into a chain of problems. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段模型逐步模擬「舊鋼腱去張、空缺期、新鋼腱張拉」三個狀態，檢查每個接縫在設計活載與溫度梯度下的應力；現場在接縫兩側安裝裂縫計或位移計，去張期間連續記錄接縫開口，超過預定警戒值（例如 0.1 mm）即停工檢討。
knowledge.textEn: Model the three construction states, old tendon detensioned, gap period and new tendon stressed, and check every joint under design live load and thermal gradient; on site, fit crack gauges or displacement transducers across joints and log opening continuously during detensioning, stopping work for review if a preset alert value such as 0.1 mm is exceeded.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 更換計畫應附上每一跨、每一條鋼腱移除時所需的交通限制表（車道封閉、重車禁行或限速），以及必要時的臨時預力棒配置，由原設計者或獨立審查工程師簽認後才能動工。
knowledge.textEn: The replacement plan should attach, for every span and every tendon, a table of required traffic restrictions (lane closure, heavy-vehicle ban or speed limit) and any temporary prestressing bars, signed by the original designer or an independent checking engineer before work starts.

quiz.question: 要驗證「移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint stress with one tendon removed"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以施工階段模型逐步模擬「舊鋼腱去張、空缺期、新鋼腱張拉」三個狀態，檢查每個接縫在設計活載與溫度梯度下的應力。
真空灌注可以讓已腐蝕的鋼腱恢復原來的強度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Model the three construction states, old tendon detensioned, gap period and new tendon stressed, and check every joint under design live load and thermal gradient.
Vacuum injection restores a corroded tendon to its original strength.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段模型逐步模擬「舊鋼腱去張、空缺期、新鋼腱張拉」三個狀態，檢查每個接縫在設計活載與溫度梯度下的應力；現場在接縫兩側安裝裂縫計或位移計，去張期間連續記錄接縫開口，超過預定警戒值（例如 0.1 mm）即停工檢討。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Model the three construction states, old tendon detensioned, gap period and new tendon stressed, and check every joint under design live load and thermal gradient; on site, fit crack gauges or displacement transducers across joints and log opening continuously during detensioning, stopping work for review if a preset alert value such as 0.1 mm is exceeded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint stress with one tendon removed: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節塊接縫底緣應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bottom-fibre stress at segment joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若沒有先算出少一條鋼腱的狀態就開放全部交通，接縫可能在重車通過時反覆張開又閉合，環氧樹脂接縫劣化、水氣進入，反而加速鄰近鋼腱的腐蝕，使一次更換演變成連鎖問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping the one-tendon-short check and keeping full traffic lets joints open and close under every heavy truck, degrading the epoxy joints and admitting moisture, which accelerates corrosion of the neighbouring tendons and turns one replacement into a chain of problems. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此更換工程的第一個問題不是怎麼切，而是少一條鋼腱時接縫會不會出現拉應力而張開，以及需要多少交通管制或臨時預力才能避免。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The first question of a replacement is therefore not how to cut, but whether the joints decompress and open with one tendon missing, and how much traffic restriction or temporary prestress prevents it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要其餘鋼腱沒斷，更換期間的橋就和平常一樣安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the other tendons are intact, the bridge is as safe as usual during a replacement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若沒有先算出少一條鋼腱的狀態就開放全部交通，接縫可能在重車通過時反覆張開又閉合，環氧樹脂接縫劣化、水氣進入，反而加速鄰近鋼腱的腐蝕，使一次更換演變成連鎖問題。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping the one-tendon-short check and keeping full traffic lets joints open and close under every heavy truck, degrading the epoxy joints and admitting moisture, which accelerates corrosion of the neighbouring tendons and turns one replacement into a chain of problems.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint stress with one tendon removed" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要灌漿的氯離子含量很低，鋼腱就不會腐蝕。
若沒有先算出少一條鋼腱的狀態就開放全部交通，接縫可能在重車通過時反覆張開又閉合，環氧樹脂接縫劣化、水氣進入，反而加速鄰近鋼腱的腐蝕，使一次更換演變成連鎖問題。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If grout chloride content is very low, the tendon cannot corrode.

Skipping the one-tendon-short check and keeping full traffic lets joints open and close under every heavy truck, degrading the epoxy joints and admitting moisture, which accelerates corrosion of the neighbouring tendons and turns one replacement into a chain of problems.
quiz.explanation: 若沒有先算出少一條鋼腱的狀態就開放全部交通，接縫可能在重車通過時反覆張開又閉合，環氧樹脂接縫劣化、水氣進入，反而加速鄰近鋼腱的腐蝕，使一次更換演變成連鎖問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Skipping the one-tendon-short check and keeping full traffic lets joints open and close under every heavy truck, degrading the epoxy joints and admitting moisture, which accelerates corrosion of the neighbouring tendons and turns one replacement into a chain of problems. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
